messages:
zoe_pm: Quick alignment thread: Merchant 'StripeFront' requested roadmap-level guarantees for an upcoming private pilot. They care about isolation, encryption-with-customer-keys, and deterministic latency for UI flows. Need cross-team commitments before we quote SLA.
raj_runtime: From runtime POV we need exact target traces (tokens, prompt patterns) and acceptable degradation modes. Can we define p95 target and what falls back to quantized stacks?
zoe_pm: Product proposes p95 <= 220ms for <200-token interactive traces. Fallback allowed but must preserve semantic fidelity for top-k responses (we'll specify eval set).
mina_infra: Capacity reality: we can reserve 5 GPUs in Dedicated (3 steady, 2 burst) with a 3-week lead time. Prewarm soak 72h recommended. Also need to know whether customer will accept shared-edge networking or require VPC peering.
olivia_sec: Security checklist summary: customer-managed KMS/HSM integration (no key export), mTLS with client certs, signed attestation report, and proof-of-forwarding to customer's SIEM. Also require CI tests that verify no key IDs are emitted to logs.
tom_eng: App integration notes: we'll gate rollout with feature flags, start at 2% canary for 24h, and need programmatic toggles to flip fallback. I will provide smoke tests and a rollback script called rollback-to-stable.sh.
raj_runtime: Proposed compatibility commitments: support for fp16 + q4 variants for pilot; int8/qu8 considered experimental. We'll publish a short compatibility matrix and a regression-risk note.
zoe_pm: Draft acceptance criteria (for internal review): - latency: <=220ms p95 for <200-token traces under nominal load - isolation: tenant-dedicated compute or VPC peering + segregated logs - keys: customer KMS/HSM used for data-encryption-without-export - reliability: automated failover documented; RTO <=5 minutes - quality: defined eval suite with top-k overlap >= 0.9 vs baseline
mina_infra: Loadtest ask: 48h steady at 1.25x expected, plus 15m spike at 3x. We will schedule once product signs capacity LOI.
olivia_sec: Add gating item: before Dedicated flip, security must perform an attestation review and a mutual-TLS termination test. I'll produce a short attestation checklist by Wed.
raj_runtime: Routing snippet (conceptual):
```
route:
  policy: latency
  canary_fraction: 0.02
  fallback_trigger: p99_latency > 1500ms
  fallback_model: model-q4_0
  preserve_kv: true
```

zoe_pm: Owners & near-term due dates: raj_runtime -> compatibility matrix + routing config (Tue); mina_infra -> capacity hold + prewarm window (Wed); olivia_sec -> attestation checklist (Wed); tom_eng -> smoke tests + rollback script (Thu); zoe_pm -> finalize pilot acceptance doc and send to customer (Fri).
deploy-bot: TASK-7721 created: "stripefront-pilot-playbook" and prewarm job scheduled 2024-06-02 02:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
olivia_sec: tiny note - logging scrub validation must be automated (CI hook) before we enable pilot.
raj_runtime: ack, will add log-scrub test and a synthetic run to verify no key IDs are emitted.
zoe_pm: OK plan looks good. We'll meet Thursday 9:30am PT to do a short preflight review and lock the doc. Thanks everyone :rocket:
